source.origin: Figma local variable catalog via xbridge search-design-system

notes.naming: Original FDS token names and slash-based hierarchy are preserved.
notes.colorValues: Current xbridge local-file search exposes token names, types, and collections but not resolved color hex values for the full file catalog. Color value fields remain null until a value-capable export is used.
notes.preferredUsage: Use semantic tokens first, component-scoped families second, and raw palette tokens only when semantic tokens are unavailable.
